description: This Java class defines a custom exception NullArgumentException used within the Apache Commons Math3 library to signal null argument violations, extending the MathIllegalArgumentException class.

classes.name: NullArgumentException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating a null argument was provided where it is not allowed.

methods.name: NullArgumentException
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a default localized message indicating null is not allowed.

methods.name: NullArgumentException(Localizable pattern, Object... arguments)
methods.description: Constructs a new exception with a specific message pattern and arguments for contextual information.
